test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Matriculation Level) Official Paper (Held On: 21 Jun, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Who caused the loss of forests?
solution:
The correct answer is People.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage states that Earth has lost one-third of its forests through **human activity**.
 
• This clearly identifies **people **as the cause of the loss of forests.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Realtors** - The passage does not specifically mention realtors as the cause of forest loss.
 
• **Animals** - The passage clearly indicates it is human activity, not animals, causing the loss of forests.
 
• **Nature** - The passage attributes the loss of forests to human activity, not natural processes.
